spans.s: aḍimai-kkāśu (SITI), Tamil; fee collected from temple servants.
aḍimai-kkāśu , ‘fee collected from the temple servants (or for their maintenance)’; see kāśu.
aḍi-kkāśu (SITI), Tamil; tax collected from stall-keepers in markets.
aḍi-kkāśu , ‘tax collected from the stall-keepers in the market’; see kāśu.

āḍi-ppaccai (SITI), Tamil; probably, prerequisites^1 payable in grain in the month of Āḍi after the harvest.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
